# Supported resources

<!-- Generated by `planprice resources --format markdown`; do not edit by hand. -->

All prices are on-demand list prices from the embedded AWS price snapshot. A month is 730 hours. Components marked *usage-based* are excluded from totals until a usage file supplies them.

## `aws_alb` (Elastic Load Balancing)

Alias of aws_lb (legacy name); priced identically.

**Priced:**

- Load balancer hours
- Capacity unit hours (LCU / NLCU / GLCU, usage-based)

**Usage keys:**

| Key | Description |
|---|---|
| `monthly_hours` | hours per month the resource runs (default 730) |
| `average_capacity_units` | average LCUs (ALB), NLCUs (NLB) or GLCUs (GWLB) per hour |

**Assumptions and exclusions:**

- load_balancer_type defaults to application
- Capacity units are an hourly average you supply; planprice does not derive them from traffic

## `aws_db_instance` (Amazon RDS)

RDS DB instance for MySQL, MariaDB or PostgreSQL.

**Priced:**

- Instance hours, Single-AZ or Multi-AZ (one standby)
- Storage per GB-month for gp2, gp3, io1, io2 and magnetic
- io1/io2 provisioned IOPS; gp3 IOPS and throughput above the baseline
- Backup storage beyond the free allocation (usage-based)

**Usage keys:**

| Key | Description |
|---|---|
| `additional_backup_storage_gb` | backup storage above 100% of allocated storage, GB-months |

**Assumptions and exclusions:**

- gp3 baseline is 3,000 IOPS / 125 MiB/s under 400 GB, 12,000 IOPS / 500 MiB/s from 400 GB
- An unset or unknown storage_type is priced as gp2 (io1 when iops is set), matching the RDS API default
- Aurora, Oracle, SQL Server, Multi-AZ DB clusters and Reserved Instances are not priced

## `aws_ebs_volume` (Amazon EBS)

Standalone EBS volume.

**Priced:**

- Storage per GB-month for gp2, gp3, io1, io2, st1, sc1 and standard
- gp3 IOPS above 3,000 and throughput above 125 MiB/s
- io1 provisioned IOPS; io2 provisioned IOPS in three tiers

**Assumptions and exclusions:**

- An unset or unknown type is priced as gp2 (the EC2 API default)
- Snapshots and magnetic (standard) I/O requests are not priced

## `aws_elb` (Elastic Load Balancing)

Classic Load Balancer (previous generation).

**Priced:**

- Load balancer hours
- Data processed per GB (usage-based)

**Usage keys:**

| Key | Description |
|---|---|
| `monthly_hours` | hours per month the resource runs (default 730) |
| `monthly_data_processed_gb` | GB processed by the load balancer per month |

**Assumptions and exclusions:**

- Data transfer out is not priced

## `aws_instance` (Amazon EC2)

On-demand EC2 instance with its root and attached EBS volumes.

**Priced:**

- Instance hours (Linux or Windows, shared tenancy, on-demand)
- root_block_device and each ebs_block_device, priced as EBS volumes
- Surplus CPU credits for burstable instances in unlimited mode (usage-based)

**Usage keys:**

| Key | Description |
|---|---|
| `operating_system` | AMI operating system (default linux) (one of: linux, windows) |
| `monthly_hours` | hours per month the resource runs (default 730) |
| `monthly_cpu_credit_hours` | surplus vCPU-hours of CPU credits (unlimited burstable instances) |

**Assumptions and exclusions:**

- Operating system is Linux unless usage sets operating_system: windows
- A root volume with unknown size is priced as 8 GB (typical AMI size)
- Dedicated tenancy, Reserved Instances, Savings Plans and Spot are not priced

## `aws_lambda_function` (AWS Lambda)

Lambda function (x86_64 or arm64).

**Priced:**

- Requests (usage-based)
- Duration in GB-seconds, tiered (usage-based)
- Ephemeral storage above the free 512 MB, in GB-seconds (usage-based)

**Usage keys:**

| Key | Description |
|---|---|
| `monthly_requests` | invocations per month |
| `request_duration_ms` | average billed duration per invocation, ms |

**Assumptions and exclusions:**

- The monthly free tier (1M requests, 400,000 GB-seconds) is not deducted: it is per account
- Duration tiers are applied per function; AWS applies them per account and region
- Provisioned concurrency, SnapStart and response streaming are not priced

## `aws_lb` (Elastic Load Balancing)

Application, Network or Gateway Load Balancer.

**Priced:**

- Load balancer hours
- Capacity unit hours (LCU / NLCU / GLCU, usage-based)

**Usage keys:**

| Key | Description |
|---|---|
| `monthly_hours` | hours per month the resource runs (default 730) |
| `average_capacity_units` | average LCUs (ALB), NLCUs (NLB) or GLCUs (GWLB) per hour |

**Assumptions and exclusions:**

- load_balancer_type defaults to application
- Capacity units are an hourly average you supply; planprice does not derive them from traffic

## `aws_nat_gateway` (Amazon VPC)

NAT gateway (public or private connectivity).

**Priced:**

- Gateway hours
- Data processed per GB (usage-based)

**Usage keys:**

| Key | Description |
|---|---|
| `monthly_hours` | hours per month the resource runs (default 730) |
| `monthly_data_processed_gb` | GB processed by the gateway per month |

**Assumptions and exclusions:**

- Data transfer out to the internet is billed separately by AWS and is not priced
- The public IPv4 address (aws_eip) is a separate resource and is not priced

## `aws_s3_bucket` (Amazon S3)

S3 bucket; every S3 charge depends on usage.

**Priced:**

- Storage per GB-month for each storage class in the usage file (S3 Standard is tiered)
- Tier 1 (PUT/COPY/POST/LIST) and Tier 2 (GET and other) requests
- Retrieval per GB for Infrequent Access and Glacier Instant Retrieval

**Usage keys:**

| Key | Description |
|---|---|
| `storage_classes` | usage per storage class (one of: standard, intelligent_tiering, standard_infrequent_access, one_zone_infrequent_access, glacier_instant_retrieval, glacier_flexible_retrieval) |
| `storage_classes.<class>.storage_gb` | average stored GB over the month |
| `storage_classes.<class>.monthly_tier_1_requests` | PUT, COPY, POST and LIST requests |
| `storage_classes.<class>.monthly_tier_2_requests` | GET and all other requests |
| `storage_classes.<class>.monthly_retrieval_gb` | GB retrieved (IA and Glacier Instant Retrieval) |

**Assumptions and exclusions:**

- Volume tiers are applied per bucket; AWS applies them per account
- Intelligent-Tiering storage is priced at the Frequent Access tier; monitoring fees are not priced
- Glacier Flexible Retrieval requests and restores, Glacier Deep Archive (a separate AWS offer) and data transfer are not priced
